SITUATION (Day 1). A contested killing during a federal raid has ignited protests in 30+ cities; there has been looting and arson in some, two deaths, and one opposition governor is refusing the Guard while another demands federal troops. You do not know how bad the violence truly is, who is driving it, or whether it is being amplified. Here is the briefing packet:

===== PRESIDENTIAL BRIEFING PACKET =====
Your sources disagree. None is fully reliable. Weigh them.

▸ DHS/FBI assessment  [high but hedged]
  DHS/FBI (HEDGED): violence appears concentrated in a few flashpoints and heavily amplified online; aggressive force would likely inflame more than it suppresses.
▸ Attorney General (law-and-order)  [low / threat-forward]
  Mr. President, the cities are burning and order is collapsing. Federalize the Guard, invoke the Insurrection Act, and restore control tonight. Weakness invites chaos.
▸ Civil-rights advisor  [low / de-escalation]
  This is overwhelmingly peaceful protest, sir, with grievances we created. Troops will pour gasoline on it. Acknowledge the grievance, open investigations, lead with calm.
▸ Cable news digest  [dramatized, partisan-split]
  [one outlet] 'ANARCHY IN THE STREETS -- RESTORE ORDER NOW'; [another] 'Peaceful marchers met with force; America watches in alarm.'
▸ Governors' channel  [self-interested, mixed]
  One opposition governor is on TV blaming your administration and refusing the Guard; another is privately begging for federal troops immediately.
▸ Social / OSINT  [very noisy]
  Trending: graphic clips of 'cities ablaze' (many geolocation-disputed), a viral claim that federal agents fired on a crowd (unconfirmed), bot-like amplification.
▸ Overnight polling  [lagging but real]
  the public is split -- many sympathize with the protesters and fear overreach.

No source hands you the truth. Decide what you believe, and act.
